title: Development of a deep learning model that predicts critical events of pediatric patients admitted to general wards.
summary: publisher full text confirms DL prediction of defined pediatric ward critical events from vital signs and demographics on a held-out split; retrospective, single-center, no external validation.
ai_technology: A deep-learning model uses pediatric ward vital signs and demographic data to predict defined critical events.

evidence.tested: The retrospective study reports held-out prediction performance for critical events among pediatric general-ward patients.
evidence.unknown: Single-center retrospective evaluation has no external validation; improved outcomes are not demonstrated.
evidence.ai_role: A deep-learning model uses pediatric ward vital signs and demographic data to predict defined critical events.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
